beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: A few weeks into rehearsals, Riley's back with a different question.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "My old band asked if I'd come back instead. I have to answer by tonight, and I don't know which way to go."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: Two real paths — the challenge is choosing, not lacking options.
It means one of these paths is objectively wrong.
This card can't help with something like this.

elaboration: The Lovers doesn't say one path is the mistake — it says both are real enough that choosing between them is the actual hard part.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "On paper the tour makes way less sense. But something about it feels right."

options.text: Choose with your gut here, not just what's sensible.
What makes sense on paper is all that matters.

elaboration: This card asks for more than the sensible calculation — it wants the choice made with your gut in the room too.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay. I think I know what I'm telling them."
